description: Fetch the observatory front page in one call — MCP servers, A2A agents, HF models, x402 money, top-5 growth with one catalog line each, new arrivals per category and data coverage, a few headline numbers each. Read-only aggregation of daily-collected observatory data; no side effects; money figures carry their stated data lag. Use when the user wants the state of the whole market in a single request; for per-metric values with formulas use `get_pulse`.
name: get_market_overview
title: Get Market Overview
